Add a unit conversion

Source: R/units.R
register_unit.Rd

Registers a conversion between two units, and optionally other spellings of them, for the rest of the session. The conversion works in both directions: value_to = value_from * factor + offset. Rates per unit of time (e.g. "in/day") do not need registering: they convert through their numerator.

Usage

register_unit(from, to, factor = 1, offset = 0, aliases = NULL)

Arguments

from, to

Unit names, e.g. "in" and "mm".

factor, offset

Multiplier and offset from from to to.

aliases

Optional named character vector of other spellings, e.g. c(inch = "in").

Value

The table of registered conversions, invisibly.

See also

convert_unit(), list_units()

Examples

register_unit("in", "mm", factor = 25.4, aliases = c(inch = "in"))
convert_unit(data.frame(ID = "1", value = 2), "mm", from = "inch")
#> # A tibble: 1 × 2
#> # Context:  value [mm], long; key ID
#>   ID    value
#>   <chr> <dbl>
#> 1 1      50.8
